entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Prime Minister Christopher Luxon has hosted India Prime Minister Narendra Modi at a range of events in Auckland, marking the first time in 40 years an Indian prime minister has come to New Zealand | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

RNZ senior journalist Gaurav Sharma recaps the busy Saturday and what it means for the country's relationships going forward.

Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/700635/luxon-and-modi-agree-on-partnership-with-trade-and-maritime-security-ambitions
